Record Class UDFFillDecision

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
grafioschtrader.udffill.UDFFillDecision
Record Components:
result - what is reported for the cell
valueAction - what happens to key f<id> in udf_data
rowAction - what happens to the fill row
public record UDFFillDecision(UDFFillWriteResult result, UDFFillDecision.ValueAction valueAction, UDFFillDecision.RowAction rowAction) extends Record
The decision table of the write rule "manual values always win". It decides from the fill row, the outcome of the source and the current value of the cell what happens to the value and to the fill row. It is pure, so that the watchlist load can decide in memory whether a write is needed at all, and UDFFillWriter applies the same decision under the row lock.

  • Method Details

    • decide

      public static UDFFillDecision decide(UDFFillState state, String filledValue, UDFFillOutcome outcome, String cur, boolean template)
      Decides for one cell.
      Parameters:
      state - the state of the fill row, or null when there is none
      filledValue - the filled value of the fill row, or null
      outcome - the outcome of the source
      cur - the canonical current value of the cell, null or empty when the cell is empty
      template - true for the fill source TEMPLATE, which never stores a NOT_FOUND row
      Returns:
      the decision

    • changesSomething

      public boolean changesSomething(Integer rowVersion, int currentVersion)
      Tells whether applying this decision changes anything in the database.
      Parameters:
      rowVersion - the rule version of the existing fill row, or null when there is none
      currentVersion - the current fill rule version of the field
      Returns:
      false when neither the value nor the fill row would change, so no write transaction is needed
